text:
Maria (PM): Heads up — GloboPay renewal is asking for a contract-level SLA: 99.95% availability + p95 request latency < 120ms for hosted text generation. Sales says it's deal-critical for this quarter. Need quick call: do we promise, negotiate, or offer an alternative?

Aj (Sales): Yep, renewal in 30 days. If we don't give something they want, they may go to a competitor. Rough ACV at risk: ~$400k. They said they'd be open to a short pilot or a paid dedicated option.

Kai (Eng): 120ms p95 for hosted inference is non-trivial at scale. Achievable with dedicated capacity + tuning (kernel selection, KV cache PRs, routing policies). Work needed: customer-specific pool + model pinning + telemetry. Ballpark: 6 dev-weeks + SRE support.

Tess (SRE): We'll need explicit SLO->SLA mapping, runbooks for failover, and an automated fallback (route to lower-guarantee pool + credits process). Also need dashboards and alerting. Legal needs to define credits cap.

Sam (CS): Customer willing to pay for dedicated capacity if it makes the contract work. They prefer a time-boxed pilot (3 months) to validate.

Maria (PM): Proposal: "SLA windowing" — short-term, negotiated SLA pilot tied to a dedicated pool paid by customer. Conditions: 3-month pilot, measurable success metrics, capped credits, automatic fallback to hosted default if we breach, rollback policy, and explicit termination clause. Product owns success criteria and RICE-based prioritization.

Aj (Sales): Can we price reserved capacity and a support uplift? Sales needs a simple offer to present: dedicated pool + 1.2x list price for 6 months or a discount if they commit to 12 months.

Olga (Legal): We'll need an SLA addendum with: definition of breach, measurement method (which telemetry source is authoritative), credit calculation, max credit cap, termination rights, and a force-majeure carveout. I can draft but need 3-5 business days.

Kai (Eng): If product greenlights pilot, immediate scope: API flagging for customer routing, admin UI for pool configs, per-tenant model pinning, added tracing for latency attribution. Est: 6 dev-weeks + 2 SRE-weeks (can compress with triage). Risks: regressions in multi-tenant scheduler and cost bump.

Tess (SRE): I'll draft the runbook prototype and required alerting/playbook items. Need product to list stakeholders for on-call rotations during pilot.

Aj (Sales): I'll send the customer the offer: dedicated pool + pilot + price uplift; will ask for sign-off on 3-month commitment.

Maria (PM): Action items + owners + deadlines:
- Aj: confirm customer's acceptance of paid pilot (by EOD + 48h)
- Kai: eng scope & risk list (by EOD)
- Tess: runbook draft (48h)
- Olga: draft SLA addendum timeline (3-5 business days)
- Raj: exec sign-off if pilot signed (hold)

Reactions:
Aj (Sales): :thumbsup:
Kai (Eng): :eyes: I will follow up with a breakdown.
Sam (CS): :pray: will coordinate customer comms.
Maria (PM): Thanks team — aiming to keep product roadmap intact while we support strategic renewals. We'll treat this as a gated pilot and re-evaluate after metrics come in.

deploy-bot: Reminder: no deploys scheduled to customer-dedicated pools without change freeze + runbook sign-off.

Aj (Sales): acked.
Kai (Eng): acked.
Tess (SRE): acked.
Olga (Legal): acked.
